mapper.select: select id, route_id, process_id, process_code, process_name, sequence_no, workstation_id, workstation_name, standard_hours, inspect_flag, inspect_type, remark, create_by, create_time from pro_route_process where route_id = #{routeId} order by sequence_no asc

select id, route_id, process_id, process_code, process_name, sequence_no, workstation_id, workstation_name, standard_hours, inspect_flag, inspect_type, remark, create_by, create_time from pro_route_process where route_id = #{routeId} and sequence_no = #{sequenceNo}
mapper.insert: insert into pro_route_process ( route_id, process_id, process_code, process_name, sequence_no, workstation_id, workstation_name, standard_hours, inspect_flag, inspect_type, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{routeId}, #{processId}, #{processCode}, #{processName}, #{sequenceNo}, #{workstationId}, #{workstationName}, #{standardHours}, #{inspectFlag}, #{inspectType}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )

insert into pro_route_process ( route_id, process_id, process_code, process_name, sequence_no, workstation_id, workstation_name, standard_hours, inspect_flag, inspect_type, remark, create_by, create_time ) values
(#{item.routeId}, #{item.processId}, #{item.processCode}, #{item.processName}, #{item.sequenceNo}, #{item.workstationId}, #{item.workstationName}, #{item.standardHours}, #{item.inspectFlag}, #{item.inspectType}, #{item.remark}, #{item.createBy}, sysdate())
